description: Hero -> hero power links. The HearthstoneJSON 6024 file has no hero to hero-power field, so the nine class heroes are paired by class (each hero power's playerClass matches); the Lord Jaraxxus link comes from the CardDefs.xml HERO_POWER tag. tools/carddata/crosscheck_carddefs.py re-verifies the XML link. The 30 Naxxramas boss heroes (15 Normal, 15 Heroic) are paired by their boss slot; Kel'Thuzad's phase-two Chains (NAX15_04 and NAX15_04H) is swapped in by the encounter and is linked from no hero.

links.source: CardDefs.xml @ HearthSim/hsdata ff82e0a (build 6024): EX1_323h has tag HERO_POWER=1178; manifest-cards.csv maps dbfId 1178 to EX1_tk33
